craft_notes: Sthāyin: watch-the-flash (desire as instruction). Rows: row 2 (flashes→dissolves). Close: you (tava as landing: dissolves INTO YOU). Rejected: 'observe the mind' — killed: watch-that kept (directed, not general); 'liberation' — kept dissolves (laya as event).

lines: When the stir of desire's spread rises — whatever flashes, watch that;
in first, in middle, in ends, if there — shine, shine; all melts into you.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāsanāprasaravibhramodaye | yad yad ullasati tad tad īkṣyatām | ādimadhyanidhaneṣu tatra ced | bhāsi bhāsi tava līyate 'khilam

reads_against.argmap: What is watched? → Desire-practice: attend the flash itself at every phase; the watcher shining, all melts into you.
c1_essence: Desire rising watched flash by flash: shining, shining, all dissolving into you.
